status: NOT VALIDATED — regime-dependent tendency; fails strict multi-decade validation
reconciliation: Cross-checked against an independent 23-year Jesse-framework analysis (2003-2026, realistic bid-ask costs, plateau + Deflated-Sharpe + RST significance + Monte-Carlo gates). That analysis tested this exact family and REJECTED it. Four reasons my earlier 'validated' claim was over-stated: (1) COSTS — my slippage ~0.33bp vs realistic ~9.31bp round-trip; their sensitivity test drops best Sharpe from 0.85 to 0.05 under real costs. (2) PERIOD — my 2020-2026 window is all-bull (gold +165%); over 23 years incl. the 2011-2015 -44.9% bear the edge disappears. (3) BETA — exposure analysis shows ~half the return is passive long exposure, and it loses to buy-and-hold (+26% vs +138%). (4) GATES — the plateau test shows it is a knife-edge parameter spike (only 0.07% of 10,008 variants cleared Sharpe 1.5 = multiple-testing luck) and its entry tests at p=0.676 (not significant). CONCLUSION: treat as a weak, cost-sensitive, regime-dependent tendency under paper observation only — NOT a proven edge.
method: 84-config search on 2020-2026 15M Dukascopy bid/ask (research/strategy_search.py). NOTE: cost model (0.10pt slippage) is now known to be ~28x too optimistic vs realistic gold spreads, and the period is a single bull regime. Numbers below are retained for transparency, not as proof.

bollinger_fade_long_v1.label: Bollinger Fade (Long, 1:1)
bollinger_fade_long_v1.rule: BUY when 1H close < lower Bollinger band(20,2); SL & TP = 1.5*ATR (1:1); long-only.
bollinger_fade_long_v1.why: OBSERVATION not edge: buying oversold dips profited 2020-2025 but that period was a gold bull market; per-year 2026 is NEGATIVE, and independent 23-year testing rejects the family.
gates: passed lenient aggregate OOS + FDR (2020-2026 only)
cost-sensitive: edge likely gone at realistic spreads

rsi_meanrev_long_v1.label: RSI Mean-Reversion (Long, 1:1)
rsi_meanrev_long_v1.rule: BUY when 1H RSI(14) < 30 AND close is > 1 ATR below EMA20; SL & TP = 1.5*ATR (1:1); long-only.
rsi_meanrev_long_v1.why: OBSERVATION not edge: same mean-reversion-long tendency as Bollinger fade; same bull-market caveat and same rejection under strict independent testing.
gates: passed lenient aggregate OOS + FDR (2020-2026 only)
